    Class
    Description
    KeyedSecret
    A key paired with the identifier an operator chose for it, as returned by KeyProvider.currentKey() and resolved by KeyProvider.resolveKey(String).
    KeyProvider
    SPI for supplying the key(s) used to seal/unseal MCP MRTR requestState continuation tokens (see AeadRequestStateCodec).
    McpBearerChallenge
    Fluent, insertion-ordered builder for a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... challenge value (RFC 6750 §3, RFC 9728 §5.1) emitted by the 2026-07-28 MCP resource server on a 401.
    McpCacheConfig
    Binding-owned, immutable-after-construction cache configuration for a v2 McpRevision.
    McpCacheHint
    A single ttlMs/cacheScope configuration pair applied to a v2 cacheable result.
    McpEndpoint
    Mixin interface that exposes a 2026-07-28 MCP endpoint at POST /mcp on any Juneau REST resource.
    McpInputRequiredSignal
    Thrown by a handler's ordinary call/get/read body to signal that it needs more input before it can complete (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322 Multi-Round-Trip Requests).
    McpMrtrConfig
    Binding-owned MRTR (Multi-Round-Trip Request) configuration for a v2 McpRevision.
    McpMrtrResumeContext
    Bean stashed into the BeanStore passed to a handler on a RESUME call, carrying the decoded continuation and the client's collected answers.
    McpOperationContext
    The resolved MCP operation an McpOperationScopeResolver decides required scopes for (SEP-2350 per-operation step-up).
    McpOperationScopeResolver
    Resolves the set of scopes required to invoke a specific MCP operation (SEP-2350 per-operation step-up enforcement).
    McpOptions
    Binding-owned behavior configuration ("how" a 2026-07-28 MCP endpoint behaves) — the single v2-only aggregate consolidating every per-binding tunable McpEndpoint/McpRestServlet previously exposed as six separate hooks: capabilities, instructions, cache, mrtr, subscriptions, and subscriptionBroker.
    McpProtectedResourceMetadata
    Server-side representation of an RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata (PRM) document, emitted by the 2026-07-28 MCP resource server from its .well-known/oauth-protected-resource endpoint so a client can discover which authorization server(s) protect this MCP server.
    McpRequestState
    The dispatcher-owned payload sealed into an opaque requestState token by RequestStateCodec.
    McpResourceServerConfig
    Binding-owned OAuth 2.1 resource-server (RS) configuration for a 2026-07-28 MCP endpoint — the F2 authorization-hardening baseline (READY-312f).
    McpSubscriptionsConfig
    Binding-owned MCP subscriptions/listen (SEP-2575) configuration for a v2 McpRevision.
    RequestStateCodec
    Pluggable SPI for sealing/unsealing the opaque requestState continuation token (MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2322 Multi-Round-Trip Requests).
    StaticKeyProvider
    Built-in, immutable, static-at-startup KeyProvider: an operator-supplied keyring of one or more AES keys, one of which is designated the current sealing key.
    StaticKeyProvider.Builder
    Builder for StaticKeyProvider.
